Task-matched conformance and reproducible benchmark evidence
Optional neural and offline runtime boundary
Provider integration boundaries and build fragments

disposition: Caller-supplied dynamic-int8 wav2vec2-base rate-encoder readiness blocker; no implementation, adapter, asset or result.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply the immutable upstream snapshot at revision 22aad52d435eb6dbaf354bdad9b0da84ce7d6156 with every file's byte count and SHA-256, the reviewed model card and license/notice bundle, and a redistribution/product-use decision.
exact_blockers.statement: The exact facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h weight snapshot is absent. The research source record pins model.safetensors at 377,607,901 bytes and SHA-256 8aa76ab2..., but no local file exists at the runner's HF_HOME, data/checkouts, data/models or the Hugging Face cache. The smallest verifiable model reference cannot be built from metadata alone, and no weight was downloaded or reconstructed.

exact_blockers.required_action: Either supply a serialized QNNPACK dynamic-int8 state dict with SHA-256/byte count, or reproduce the exact FP32 snapshot plus the pinned quantization recipe in the locked runtime and pin the resulting artifact and quantized parameter inventory.
exact_blockers.statement: No quantized encoder artifact is present. The historical pilot quantized in memory with QNNPACK and saved only mean-pooled embeddings; int8_embeddings.npz is a derived feature archive, not a quantized state dict. The recipe source is pinned, but its output bytes and runtime behavior are not.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply a locked offline environment with exact Python/torch/transformers versions, wheel hashes, install/import digest, QNNPACK engine selection, deterministic settings and one intra-op/one inter-op thread, then record a clean-room import and load.
exact_blockers.statement: No pinned runtime is present. Python 3.10.13 with torch 2.2.2, transformers 4.40.2 and QNNPACK is required, but the pinned CPython 3.12.16 and the available 3.11.5 interpreters expose no torch or transformers, and the historical data/envs/sylnet-py310 environment is absent. No import, quantization or inference was attempted.

exact_blockers.required_action: Freeze a permitted, speaker/meeting-disjoint rate cohort with reviewed AMI/corpus and CMUdict terms, independently checked syllable labels, language/speaker groups and source-timestamp provenance.
exact_blockers.statement: The historical cohort is one AMI EN2003a meeting (210 four-second windows), not a rights-cleared multi-meeting rate corpus. Reference syllables come from AMI orthographic transcripts plus CMUdict first pronunciations, not human syllable-nucleus labels. AMI audio/annotation and CMUdict terms have not been reviewed here, and no audio byte was read for this package.

exact_blockers.required_action: Run the paired FP32 and dynamic-int8 paths on the qualified cohort with a frozen scorer, exact folds, nonfinite/output checks, identity and constant baselines, and adverse/missing controls.
exact_blockers.statement: No FP32/int8 accuracy, embedding-fidelity or finite-output comparison was reproduced. The pilot's recorded MAE/RMSE/r and median embedding cosine are quoted context only; the archived embeddings are not loaded, scored or promoted, and no adverse or missing-input control was exercised against a real encoder.

exact_blockers.required_action: After model/data/runtime/quality gates clear, measure the exact target-device paced workload and complete the Rate profile, then open a separate OFF-by-default versioned provider intake with independent exact-head review.
exact_blockers.statement: No provider, adapter, descriptor or intake exists. The candidate has no SDK registration, no public ABI/registry/default/build or CI change, no device-timing or resource measurement, and no rate-to-speed policy. Int8 was about six times slower than FP32 on the historical host, so no latency or product claim follows.

non_claims: No wav2vec2 weight, quantized state dict or tokenizer asset is present.
No torch, transformers or QNNPACK runtime is imported or executed.
No audio, transcript, syllable label or derived embedding is read or scored.
No FP32/int8 accuracy, embedding fidelity or speed result is reproduced.
No listening, device timing, benchmark, pipeline or release claim is made.
No provider, registry, descriptor, public ABI, shared build or CI change exists.
A syllables/second estimate is not a preferred speed factor or a TSM setting.

quality_outcomes.evidence: Recorded pilot FP32 CV is provenance only; no local score was reproduced.
No paired FP32/int8 run exists; the recorded delta is not a local result.
The archived embedding cosine is not loaded, scored or recomputed.
The recorded ~6x slowdown is host context, not a reproduced target-device result.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: The candidate is a rate estimator, not a TSM renderer, and no source/output mapping or duration result exists.
No rendered output, F0/transient metric or listening result exists for an int8 rate path.
No playback chain, queue, fill/flush or buffering measurement exists.
No 1x or rate-change comparison exists; a syllables/second estimate is not a speed factor.
The historical pilot is one AMI meeting of speech; no unfamiliar speech, music, silence or language coverage was tested.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include unfamiliar speech, music and silence.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No stream, rebuffer, clock-drift or partial-window behavior was measured.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include rebuffer, drift and the final partial window.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No pause/filler controller, source-timestamp mapping or speech-preservation measurement exists.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Keep pause or filler decisions tied to source timestamps and measure speech preservation.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No preference/acceptability labels or rate-to-speed policy exists; none is inferred from the historical syllable-rate score.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Map estimated rate to a reviewed preferred-speed policy.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Pin the exact source archive/tree and 40-hex revision, stage the complete model card and Apache-2.0 license/notice set, and record an independent terms review.
release_gates.statement: The upstream model revision is recorded from the research source record, but the immutable source archive/tree, complete model card, license and notice bundle are not staged or reviewed.
release_gates.title: source_revision_and_license_provenance

release_gates.reopen_condition: Supply the immutable weight snapshot with per-file digests and a reproducible/pinned quantized artifact, then verify both against the recorded source record.
release_gates.statement: No weight file or quantized state dict is present; only documented upstream digests and an in-memory quantization recipe exist.
release_gates.title: weights_assets_and_quantized_artifact

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide a locked offline runtime and install/import digest, load the pinned snapshot with networking disabled, perform dynamic Linear-only int8 quantization, and record deterministic repeat outputs.
release_gates.statement: The exact Python/torch/transformers/QNNPACK runtime is absent and no offline load, quantization or inference was executed.
release_gates.title: pinned_runtime_and_offline_quantization

release_gates.reopen_condition: Freeze a permitted, speaker/meeting-disjoint cohort with reviewed corpus and dictionary terms, independent syllable labels and source-timestamp provenance.
release_gates.statement: No rights-cleared multi-meeting rate cohort or human-checked syllable labels are staged; the historical pilot is one meeting with transcript-derived labels.
release_gates.title: rights_cleared_rate_corpus_and_labels

release_gates.reopen_condition: Reproduce both paths on the qualified cohort with fixed folds and a frozen scorer, including embedding cosine, accuracy/bias/correlation, finite-output and constant-baseline controls.
release_gates.statement: No paired FP32/int8 reproduction, embedding-fidelity check, nonfinite scan or accuracy delta is available; recorded numbers are not local results.
release_gates.title: fp32_int8_equivalence_and_accuracy

release_gates.reopen_condition: Score the exact Rate-profile cases with separate source references and a timestamp-tied pause/filler policy, preserving speech and reporting duration/alignment.
release_gates.statement: The Rate profile is not exercised: no source/output mapping, duration, pitch/transient, buffering, rate-change, unfamiliar speech/music/silence, rebuffer/drift, final-partial-window or pause/filler decision evidence exists.
release_gates.title: rate_profile_condition_coverage

release_gates.reopen_condition: Measure the exact installed candidate under paced workload with p95/p99 callback/deadline, resource, thermal/energy and fill/flush behavior on the intended device.
release_gates.statement: No target-device timing, CPU/memory/energy, queue, deadline or rebuffer measurement exists. The historical int8 host run was slower than FP32 and is not a device result.
release_gates.title: target_runtime_timing_resources_and_deadlines

release_gates.reopen_condition: Open a separate versioned, OFF-by-default opt-in provider intake with an exact asset/descriptor/config, clean-install proof and independent exact-head review after all prior gates clear.
release_gates.statement: No provider/intake/public-surface/release decision exists; the installed v0 geometry and shared build remain untouched.
release_gates.title: provider_intake_public_surface_and_release

required_artifacts.requirement: The exact historical neural-rate runner, upstream source record, results JSON, cohort manifest and derived FP32/int8 embedding archives pinned by SHA-256.

The immutable facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h snapshot at revision 22aad52d435eb6dbaf354bdad9b0da84ce7d6156 with model.safetensors, config.json, preprocessor/feature-extractor configs and tokenizer assets, plus per-file byte counts and SHA-256.

A reproducible QNNPACK dynamic-int8 artifact: either a serialized quantized state dict with SHA-256 and byte count, or the exact FP32 snapshot plus a locked quantization recipe whose output is itself pinned by digest.
A locked, offline runtime with Python 3.10.13, torch 2.2.2, transformers 4.40.2, the QNNPACK quantized engine, one intra-op and one inter-op thread, and an install/import digest.
A rights-cleared, held-out speech-rate cohort with permitted AMI audio, checked transcript-derived syllable labels, language and speaker/meeting groups, and more than one meeting.
A fresh FP32/int8 paired run with reproduced accuracy, embedding fidelity, finite-output checks, adverse controls and a frozen scoring bundle on the qualified cohort.
A separate versioned opt-in SDK provider intake with OFF default, empty descriptor settings, no registry/default/build change and independent exact-head review after every other gate clears.

required_results: Exact upstream snapshot revision, per-file byte counts and SHA-256.
Reviewed model-card, weight and notice terms plus product-use decision.
Serialized or reproducibly pinned QNNPACK dynamic-int8 artifact.
Rights-cleared multi-meeting rate cohort with checked syllable labels.
Paired FP32/int8 accuracy, embedding, finite-output and adverse controls.
Exact Rate-profile mapping, buffering, condition and preservation evidence.
Target-device p95/p99 timing, resources and deadline behavior.
Separate OFF-by-default provider intake and independent exact-head review.

timing_requirements.evidence: No local encoder timing was measured.
No device, pacing or callback deadline was measured.
No resource, thermal or energy measurement exists.
